entities.name: Shintan
entities.description: Personal guard of Khan Narset at Sage Eye Stronghold in Tarkir's original timeline.

entities.name: Narset
entities.description: Jeskai khan who sneaks off to read and fights off orcs.

entities.name: Taigam
entities.description: Traitor alleged to have hired the orc assassins.

events.summary: Narset sneaks away from her meditation, leaving a decoy for Shintan to watch.
events.quote: She quickly constructed a decoy, dressed in the same clothes

events.summary: Eight orcs ambush the plaza and hold Shintan; Narset finds her decoy destroyed.
events.quote: she found eight formerly Abzan orcs standing within, holding Shintan

events.summary: Narset and Shintan fight off and defeat the orcs.
events.quote: Narset delivered a kick to the commander orc's throat.

events.summary: Shintan reveals the orcs were hired by Taigam; the elders doubt the orcs.
events.quote: they had been hired by the traitor Taigam

relations.quote: Shintan was the personal guard of Khan Narset
